articles.title: Fireblocks launches agentic payment support, joins x402 Foundation
articles.snippet: If even a fraction of the more than 1 billion people who use AI daily delegate authority to AI agents for online spending, stablecoin adoption would grow substantially, a Fireblocks executive said.

articles.title: GitHub investigates unauthorized access to internal repositories
articles.snippet: GitHub said the activity involved the exfiltration of about 3,800 internal repositories, and it removed the malicious code extension.
